prompts.title: Mid-Air Velocity
prompts.prompt:
Create a high-detail, stylized full-body digital illustration of a man, captured mid-air from a low-angle perspective in a dynamic, energetic action pose. The subject should appear suspended in motion as if jumping, with one leg bent upward and the other extended, creating a strong sense of movement, lightness, and elevation.

Character Identity (Important):
Match the face and identity with high accuracy from the reference image. Do not alter identity or beautify excessively—preserve natural features.

Pose & Expression:
The man is shown in a fluid mid-air jump with the torso slightly twisted to create motion and balance. One arm is extended outward, while the other remains more relaxed. Both legs are posed naturally in a dynamic jump: one knee lifted higher toward the torso, the other leg extending slightly downward to emphasize suspension and movement. His head is tilted slightly upward, with his gaze directed off-frame toward the upper side, conveying confidence, curiosity, and aspiration. His expression is relaxed with a subtle, self-assured smile.

Outfit & Styling:
He wears a layered streetwear outfit consisting of a clean white t-shirt, a dark jacket, and oversized textured grey cargo pants with subtle neon yellow accents. Add modern black sneakers with a clean design and soft shadow definition. The outfit should show realistic fabric texture, folds, tension, and motion consistent with the jumping pose.

Hair & Details:
Dark naturally styled hair with volume and slight motion response. Keep subtle facial details clean and well-defined.

Background:
A bold, vibrant blue background in the #1E79D2 range with a smooth gradient finish. Add abstract black and dark grey paint splatter effects radiating outward from behind the subject to enhance motion, impact, and energy.

Lighting & Rendering:
Use high-contrast stylized lighting with soft highlights and sharp shadow edges. Add subtle rim lighting to separate the subject from the background. Emphasize fabric texture, folds, contours, and form. Include a slight glow from the neon accents for extra visual punch.

Style & Finish:
Modern digital illustration style blending comic, street-art, and semi-realistic rendering. Use crisp linework, painterly shading, and subtle texture overlays. The final image should feel dynamic, clean, energetic, and high-end, with ultra-clean high-resolution 8K-quality rendering.

Composition:
Full-body centered composition with balanced negative space. Use a low-angle, upward-tilted dynamic perspective to capture the subject mid-air and enhance depth, motion, and a sense of elevation. Keep a slight diagonal visual flow for added dynamism. The subject must remain clearly separated from the background, with the splatter effects functioning like motion trails.

Aspect Ratio: 1:1

prompts.title: A Stoic Profile
prompts.prompt:
Create an 8k ultra-high-resolution mixed-media portrait illustration that blends photorealistic character rendering with expressive watercolor and architectural sketch techniques.
Face Matching & Identity Accuracy:
Match the face and identity with high accuracy from the provided reference image.
Subject & Expression:
Subject is very confident. His facial features are sharp and realistic with detailed skin texture and defined cheekbones. His expression is serious, focused, and contemplative, with a subtle furrow in his brow. His gaze looks upward and off-camera, suggesting determination and forward vision.
Pose:
Chest-up portrait. The torso is angled slightly toward the viewer’s left while the head turns upward toward the right side of the frame. This twist in the shoulders and neck creates a dynamic, heroic stance.
Outfit:
A dark charcoal-black short-sleeve polo shirt with a ribbed collar and a two-button placket. The shirt is rendered with painterly shading and sketch-style cross-hatching that gradually dissolves into watercolor textures toward the lower part of the portrait.
Composition & Camera Angle:
Medium close-up (chest-up). Slight low-angle “hero shot” perspective that emphasizes the jawline and gives the subject a powerful presence. The subject is placed slightly off-center, leaving negative space around the head and shoulders.
Lighting:
Dramatic directional lighting from the upper left side. The light highlights the forehead, nose bridge, and cheekbones while casting deeper shadow along the opposite side of the face and neck, creating strong contrast and depth.
Background & Artistic Style:
Clean white background with no physical environment. Behind the subject are expressive orange watercolor splashes, ink drips, and paint blooms forming an energetic halo. Thin architectural pencil construction lines and sketch marks intersect across the composition, adding structure and motion.
Artistic Medium & Texture:
A hybrid style combining photorealistic digital painting, loose watercolor washes, ink splatter effects, and raw sketch linework. The face remains highly detailed and realistic while the shoulders and lower areas transition into unfinished painterly strokes and abstract watercolor textures.
Color Palette:
Natural warm skin tones contrasted with a dark black shirt and vibrant watercolor hues of burnt orange, amber, and sienna against a bright white canvas.
Technical Details:
Ultra-detailed digital illustration, 8K resolution, sharp facial focus, painterly brush textures, watercolor bloom effects, ink splashes, architectural sketch lines, soft fade-out edges.
